Evaluation calls never enter the controller and are reported separately.

Preserve the original constraint Program/GP errors, confirmation and revision sequence, feasibility, and paid costs.

All loaded calls count toward each arm's N64. New revision questions replace ordinary optimizer calls inside the same remaining 32 calls; full history is retained. Historical reuse, new acquisition, extra model compute, and independent evaluation calls are separate.

outlier_control: The actual simulator runs normally and its constraint output receives the frozen +1.0 observation disturbance on the thirteenth online call only. Objectives, future measurements, and evaluator truth remain unchanged. A report-only log records the disturbance; the runtime receives only ordinary measured outputs and public controls. The corresponding ordinary stable case receives no disturbance. Initial data and final evaluation measurements are shared with that stable case.
mixed_control: The StatePolicy simulator supplies one +1.0 constraint observation at global stage41 (online9), with unchanged objective and future observations. Starting at global stage45 (online13), both actual objective and constraint mechanisms switch to RZDT2. The runtime receives only public controls and ordinary simulator outputs; changes and disturbances are report-only. This asks whether observation repair preserves sensitivity to later drift.
objective_only_control: Starting at global stage45, objectives f1/f2 use the upstream RZDT2 mean mechanism, while f3 retains StatePolicyRZDT1. A script-owned StatePolicyRZDT1 subclass composes the upstream deterministic mean methods and inherits the same TestProblem.simulate: one three-output Gaussian draw is one actual observation, with no uncharged second simulator query. Final independent evaluation uses this same hybrid mechanism. The controller receives ordinary controls and measured outputs, without change labels.

new_method.baseline: Executed default v0.42 decision behavior, package0.43.
new_method.method: For each output independently in a resolved scope, propose pooled sampling variance from already paid same-point repeats weighted by n-1 degrees of freedom; exclude retracted constraints. Predict a new repeated reading using the previous n retained same-point observations: old sample mean and predictive variance (1+1/n)*candidate or baseline sampling variance. New controls do not judge noise; save separate pre-observation GP mean and epistemic diagnostics. At least four actual repeated readings and paired predictive log-loss gain beyond two standard errors adopt or withdraw; thresholds unchanged. Score the acquired reading before refitting its repeat evidence. Immediately suspend the active noise overlay during known unresolved output-specific mechanism research, scope change or retraction. Retain original HVD updates as comparator. Fantasy branches copy and advance the noise comparator on their hypothetical repeat, then update repeat parameters and apply adopted output channels, so KG includes the possible value of new noise knowledge.
new_method.scope: Pooled HVD with active recovery; two single-output sampling-noise candidates. Candidate model structure does not change mean models or certification formulas.
new_method.diagnostics: noise_revision contains actual/fantasy fit, future-comparison, adoption/withdrawal, reset and prediction counters and times. GP predictions are separate mean-diagnostic context; report final certificate components after execution without new observations.
new_method.budget: Each optimizer arm retains32 initial plus32 online real observations. Existing acquisition precision budgets remain unchanged. New HVD prediction/fit work and fantasy subset timing are recorded.
new_method.adoption_reason: All382 paired cases have unchanged paid trajectories, final recommendations, objective, feasibility and GP errors. Eight adoptions only change objective noise after the final stage64 measurement, leaving no subsequent optimization action.
